headline: Matched temporal geometry did not eliminate observer-selection false positives; it isolated them as a dominant residual systematic.
key_result: Observer-side selection can produce large RR and low permutation p-values without any fission events, even after same-seed matched event-window geometry is enforced.
methodological_conclusion: RR magnitude and low p-value are not sufficient for causal attribution; observation/selection controls must be part of the admission gate.
limitations: The v0.2.1 dataset does not contain a dedicated placebo_p column, so PLACEBO_FPR is not yet estimable from this dataset.
Mann-Whitney separation of RR distributions is descriptive and is not proof of causality.
